description:
# Reference: DPC4-ChampSim/replacement/mockingjay, single-core build. Sizes are for
# the DPC4 LLC, 4096 x 12: INF_RD 95, INF_ETR 11, MAX_RD 73, 11-bit signatures,
# 32 sampled sets. The multi-core build folds the core id instead of the hit bit,
# inserts an unknown signature at INF_ETR, and scales prefetch samples by less.
name: mockingjay
doc: >
  Mockingjay: each line holds an estimated time to reuse (ETR), counted down every
  8 accesses to its set; the victim is the line with the largest |ETR|, an overdue
  (negative) one on ties. A predictor table keyed by the hit-or-miss PC signature
  gives the ETR on insertion, and a fill predicted to be reused after every line in
  the set is bypassed. A sampled shadow cache on 32 sets measures reuse distances
  with an 8-bit per-set clock and trains the predictor one step at a time; entries
  older than INF_RD train it up as scans. Writebacks are inserted at -INF_ETR and
  train nothing.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:                # the incoming line is predicted to be reused after every resident
    - {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
    - {table_exceeds_victim: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # mockingjay.cc access(): the CRC2 update body, shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

name: mockingjay_confident_bypass
doc: >
  Mockingjay with a confidence mechanism for its bypass decisions. A new 2-bit
  confidence counter per RDP entry is incremented on sampled reuses and
  decremented on misses. Bypasses now require a minimum confidence level, aiming
  to reduce the number of wrong bypasses.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - confident_bypass_rdp: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_confidence, index: pc_sig, rdp_thresh: 73, conf_thresh: 3}
    - confident_bypass_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_confidence, index: pc_sig, div: 8, conf_thresh: 2}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_confidence
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: 0

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        run: train_on_reuse_prefetch
        free: true
        stop: true
      - run: train_on_reuse
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        run: train_on_miss
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - run: train_on_miss
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # mockingjay.cc access(): the CRC2 update body, shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}
  train_on_reuse:
    - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 16}
    - train: {table: rdp_confidence, index: signature, op: increment}
  train_on_reuse_prefetch:
    - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
    - train: {table: rdp_confidence, index: signature, op: increment}
  train_on_miss:
    - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    - train: {table: rdp_confidence, index: signature, op: decrement}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access
new_words_text:
- name: confident_bypass_rdp
  place: condition
  params: {rdp_table: table, conf_table: table, index: signature, rdp_thresh: {int: [0, 127]}, conf_thresh: {int: [0, 3]}}
  means: >
    True if the entry in rdp_table at the given index is present and its value is greater than rdp_thresh,
    AND the entry in conf_table at the given index has a value of at least conf_thresh.
    False if the rdp_table entry is absent.

- name: confident_bypass_victim
  place: condition
  params: {rdp_table: table, conf_table: table, index: signature, div: {int: [1, 1024]}, conf_thresh: {int: [0, 3]}}
  means: >
    Reads the victim key of the chosen victim way. Reads the rdp_table entry at the given index;
    if absent, the value is 0. True if this rdp value, divided by div (integer division),
    is greater than the absolute value of the victim key, AND the entry in conf_table at the given
    index has a value of at least conf_thresh. This word can only be used in bypass_when.

  the sampler without reuse (which Mockingjay treats as a scan). A bypass

- name: confident_long_reuse_pred
  place: condition
  params: {rdp: table, conf: table, index: signature, rdp_thresh: {int: [0, 127]}}
  means: >
    True when the rdp table entry at the index is present and its value is greater than
    rdp_thresh, AND the conf table entry at the same index is present and its value
    is its maximum value (2^width - 1). False otherwise.

- name: confident_table_exceeds_victim
  place: condition
  params: {rdp: table, conf: table, index: signature, div: {int: [1, 128]}}
  means: >
    True when the rdp table entry at the index is present, its value divided by div
    (integer division) is greater than the absolute value of the chosen victim's key,
    AND the conf table entry at the index is present and its value is its maximum value
    (2^width - 1). False otherwise. Only for use in bypass_when.

- name: train_rdp_toward_conf_inc
  place: step
  params: {rdp_table: table, conf_table: table, index: signature, sample: {symbol: [age]}, scale: {int: [1, 10]}, min_diff: {int: [0, 127]}}
  means: >
    Trains the rdp_table toward the sample value (age), scaled by scale, with a minimum
    difference of min_diff. Simultaneously, increments the conf_table entry at the same index.
    The rdp_table training is identical to the 'toward' TrainOp. The conf_table training is
    identical to the 'increment' TrainOp.

- name: train_rdp_inc_conf_dec
  place: step
  params: {rdp_table: table, conf_table: table, index: signature}
  means: >
    Increments the rdp_table entry at the given index. Simultaneously, decrements
    the conf_table entry at the same index. The training for each table is identical
    to the 'increment' and 'decrement' TrainOp respectively.

description:
name: mj_conf_bypass
doc: >
  Mockingjay with a confidence mechanism for its bypass predictor, to reduce
  wrong bypasses. A 2-bit confidence counter is associated with each entry in
  the reuse distance predictor (RDP) table. Confidence is increased upon a
  measured reuse in the sampler, and decreased when a line is evicted from
  the sampler without reuse (which Mockingjay treats as a scan). A bypass
  decision now requires both a long predicted reuse distance and maximum confidence.

    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:                # A bypass requires a long predicted reuse and high confidence
    - confident_long_reuse_pred: {rdp: rdp, conf: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, rdp_thresh: 73}

description:
name: mockingjay_faster_aging
doc: >
  Mockingjay with faster ETR aging. The per-set etr_clock now ages lines every
  4 accesses to the set, instead of every 8. This aims to make dead blocks
  (those never reused) reach very negative ETR values faster, thus improving
  their eviction priority and reducing 'kept_dead' mistakes.
  ---
  Original Mockingjay: each line holds an estimated time to reuse (ETR), counted down every
  8 accesses to its set; the victim is the line with the largest |ETR|, an overdue
  (negative) one on ties. A predictor table keyed by the hit-or-miss PC signature
  gives the ETR on insertion. A sampled shadow cache on 32 sets measures reuse distances
  with an 8-bit per-set clock and trains the predictor one step at a time; entries
  older than INF_RD train it up as scans. Writebacks are inserted at -INF_ETR and
  train nothing.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 4                   # GRANULARITY changed from 8 to 4
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:                # the incoming line is predicted to be reused after every resident
    - {table_exceeds_victim: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

  access:                     # mockingjay.cc access(): the CRC2 update body, shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 4}} # GRANULARITY changed from 8 to 4

        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}

    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}

description:
name: mockingjay_dead_conf_bypass
doc: >
  Modifies Mockingjay's bypass with a 'deadness confidence' mechanism to reduce
  should_bypass and kept_dead mistakes. A new 2-bit confidence table (dead_conf)
  is associated with the reuse distance predictor (rdp). This table tracks how
  confident the policy is that a line associated with a signature is 'dead' (not
  reused). Confidence is trained by the sampler: decremented on reuse (match),
  incremented on eviction without reuse (replace/sweep). A line is now bypassed
  only if the rdp predicts a long reuse distance AND the confidence that the
  line is dead is high (i.e., dead_conf is at its maximum value).

    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5
    init: 0

    kind: counter

    init: 8
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Use dead_conf: if dead_conf is MAX (confident it's dead) AND rdp predicts long reuse
    - confident_rdp_greater_than: {conf_table: dead_conf, rdp_table: rdp, index: pc_sig, threshold: 73}
    - confident_table_exceeds_victim: {conf_table: dead_conf, rdp_table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95
    unset: true
  - name: dead_conf # Renamed from rdp_conf to reflect its new meaning

    ways: 4

    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:

        stop: true
      - train: {table: dead_conf, index: signature, op: decrement} # Decrement dead_conf on match (it was not dead)
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}

      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}

      stop: true

description:
name: mj_conf_bypass_v2
doc: >
  Corrected the confidence training logic: confidence is now incremented when a line
  is observed to be dead (evicted from sampler without reuse) and decremented when
  reused. This aligns `rdp_conf` with 'confidence in long reuse distance' predictions,
  aiming to fix `wrong_bypass` and `kept_dead`. Renamed custom condition words
  to avoid clashes with previously accepted words. The bypass and eviction logic
  remain the same, utilizing this corrected confidence.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:                # A bypass requires a long predicted reuse and high confidence
    - my_confident_rdp_gt_threshold: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, rdp_thresh: 80} # Stricter threshold for bypass
    - my_confident_rdp_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 10} # Stricter divisor for bypass

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_rdp_toward_conf_dec: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_rdp_toward_conf_dec: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, scale: 1, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train_rdp_inc_conf_inc: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train_rdp_inc_conf_inc: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # mockingjay.cc access(): the CRC2 update body, shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {my_confident_rdp_gt_threshold: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, rdp_thresh: 73}} # Set etr=11 for confidently dead blocks
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

- name: my_confident_rdp_gt_threshold
  place: condition
  params: {rdp_table: table, conf_table: table, index: signature, rdp_thresh: {int: [0, 127]}}
  means: >
    True when the rdp_table entry at the index is present and its value is greater than
    rdp_thresh, AND the conf_table entry at the same index is present and its value
    is its maximum value (2^width - 1). False otherwise.

- name: my_confident_rdp_exceeds_victim
  place: condition
  params: {rdp_table: table, conf_table: table, index: signature, div: {int: [1, 128]}}
  means: >
    True when the rdp_table entry at the index is present, its value divided by div

    AND the conf_table entry at the index is present and its value is its maximum value
    (2^width - 1). False otherwise. Only for use in bypass_when.

    the conf_table entry at the same index. The training for each table is identical
    to the 'increment' TrainOp.

description:
name: mj_conservative_bypass
doc: >
  To reduce wrong_bypass mistakes, this design makes the bypass condition more
  conservative. It removes the bypass rule that relied on a fixed RDP threshold.
  Now, a line is only bypassed if it is confidently predicted to have a longer
  reuse distance than the chosen victim. This makes every bypass decision relative
  to the current state of the cache set, preventing bypasses of useful lines when
  the whole set contains very 'dead' lines.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when: # Bypass only when incoming is confidently worse than victim.
    - confident_table_exceeds_victim: {conf_table: rdp_conf, rdp_table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf # Tracks confidence in RDP's scan prediction.
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4
    ways: 5 # Restore original Mockingjay sampler size for accuracy.
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match: # A reuse was detected.
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement} # Decrement confidence in scan.
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
    sweep: # A line aged out without reuse (scan-like behavior).
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: increment} # Increment confidence in scan.
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace: # A line was evicted without reuse (scan).
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: increment} # Increment confidence in scan.
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    # If confidence in scan is high, evict quickly.
    - when: {table: {table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, cmp: is_max, threshold: MAX}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access
new_words_text:
- name: confident_table_exceeds_victim
  place: condition
  params: {conf_table: table, rdp_table: table, index: signature, div: {int: [1, 1024]}}
  means: >
    True if the entry for the index in conf_table is present and at its maximum value, AND
    the value from rdp_table[index]/div (integer division) is greater than the absolute

description:
name: mj_confidence_and_faster_learning
doc: >
  Reverts the faster ETR aging from the previous attempt, as it decreased performance.
  This design re-introduces the confidence mechanism and faster RDP learning parameters
  from the previously highest-performing variants. A 2-bit confidence counter is trained
  by the sampler on reuse (increment) and eviction/timeout (decrement). Lines with
  low-confidence reuse predictions (confidence < 2) are given an ETR penalty (+2),
  making them more likely eviction candidates to reduce `kept_dead` mistakes.
  The RDP training uses a `min_diff` of 4 for faster adaptation, and the initial ETR for
  unseen signatures is 4. The bypass logic includes both a static threshold and a
  comparison against the victim's RDP.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # Reverted from 4 to 8 (original Mockingjay granularity)
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:                # the incoming line is predicted to be reused after every resident
    - {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}} # Re-added this bypass condition
    - {table_exceeds_victim: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_confidence      # Added 2-bit confidence table
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 4} # min_diff changed from 16 to 4
      - when: {type_not_in: [PREFETCH]} # Added this rule
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 4} # min_diff changed from 16 to 4
      - train: {table: rdp_confidence, index: signature, op: increment} # Train confidence on match
        free: true            # Free after confidence increment
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}} # Added rule
        train: {table: rdp_confidence, index: signature, op: decrement} # Decrement confidence on old entry
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_confidence, index: signature, op: decrement} # Decrement confidence on replacement
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # mockingjay.cc access(): the CRC2 update body, shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}} # Reverted from 4 to 8
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}} # Reverted from 4 to 8
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 4}} # Changed from 0 to 4 (more conservative initial ETR)
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp_confidence, index: pc_sig, cmp: lt, threshold: 2}} # Apply ETR penalty for low confidence
      set: {etr: {add: 2}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

description:
name: mockingjay_fastlearn_conf_bypass_fix
doc: >
  Mockingjay: each line holds an estimated time to reuse (ETR), counted down every
  8 accesses to its set; the victim is the line with the largest |ETR|, an overdue
  (negative) one on ties. A predictor table keyed by the hit-or-miss PC signature
  gives the ETR on insertion, and a fill predicted to be reused after every line in
  the set is bypassed. A sampled shadow cache on 32 sets measures reuse distances
  with an 8-bit per-set clock and trains the predictor one step at a time; entries
  older than INF_RD train it up as scans. A 2-bit confidence counter is added per
  RDP entry, incremented on sampled reuses and decremented on misses. Bypass decisions
  now require a minimum confidence level (3 out of 3), aiming to reduce wrong bypasses.
  Writebacks are inserted at -INF_ETR and train nothing.

  This version fixes previous syntax errors related to multiple 'train' actions in a
  single rule by introducing new helper words. It also incorporates faster learning
  by reducing the RDP min_diff from 16 to 4, and sets a more conservative initial
  ETR of 4 for absent RDP entries (was 0), aiming to reduce both wrong_bypass and
  kept_dead mistakes.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:                # the incoming line is predicted to be reused after every resident
    - {confident_bypass_rdp: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_confidence, index: pc_sig, rdp_thresh: 73, conf_thresh: 3}}
    - {confident_bypass_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_confidence, index: pc_sig, div: 8, conf_thresh: 3}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_confidence
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2                  # 0-3 confidence level
    init: 0

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_rdp_toward_conf_inc: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_confidence, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 4} # min_diff changed from 16 to 4
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_rdp_toward_conf_inc: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_confidence, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 4} # min_diff changed from 16 to 4, explicit scale 1
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train_rdp_inc_conf_dec: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_confidence, index: signature}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train_rdp_inc_conf_dec: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_confidence, index: signature}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # mockingjay.cc access(): the CRC2 update body, shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 4}} # Changed from 0 to 4
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

- name: train_rdp_toward_conf_inc
  place: step
  params:
    rdp_table: table
    conf_table: table
    index: signature
    sample: sampler
    scale: {int: [1, 10]}
    min_diff: {int: [0, 127]}
  means: >
    Trains the rdp_table toward the value 'sample', scaled by scale, with a minimum difference of

- name: train_rdp_inc_conf_dec

    Increments the rdp_table entry at the given index. Simultaneously, decrements the conf_table
    entry at the same index. The training for each table is identical to the 'increment' and 'decrement'
    TrainOp respectively.

  kept_dead errors. The on_hit promotion is simplified to setting ETR to zero, a robust behavior
  from the original Mockingjay, to better protect recently used lines.
